messages:
deploy-bot: Planned rollout scheduled: 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. Services: runtime -> api -> router -> console. Rolling 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Pauses at 10m at 25% and manual signoff at 50%. Ops notes below.

josh: Quick ask — are we pinning runtime to v2.1.0 or staying on v2.0.x? Kernel batching change in v2.1.

anika: runtime: we need v2.1.0 for the new attention kernel. Backwards compatible but requires KV_CACHE_FAST flag=true. If we pin older, we lose batching improvement.

tara: api: schema change to /v1/generate header 'x-rdwd-model' optional. We'll add fallback to old header. No breaking change but need api-server v3.4.0 to properly accept new header.

leo: router: routing table format changes in router v5.0 -> needs route-migration flag. If runtime switches kernels and reports new model-id, old router may route to default. Propose pin router to v5.0 and enable migration window.

maya: console: UI will read model metadata that v2.1 emits. We'll gate behind feature flag 'model-meta-v2'. No console deploy unless flag stays OFF and turned on at 50%.

qa-bot: Requested tests: integration smoke (runtime->api->router), long-tail latency sweep, and failure injection (drop outbound from runtime). Can we get a staging image with runtime v2.1 + api v3.4 for staging verification?

josh: We'll build staging image today. Devops, can you schedule the staging run and run QA checklist?

devops: Staging slot booked 2026-03-23 22:00 UTC. Canary windows proposed: 15m at 5%, 20m at 25%, 30m at 50% with health checks every 30s. Rollback triggers: 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase >30% vs baseline.

maya: Confirm console flag toggles are ready. Frontend code behind 'model-meta-v2' and default OFF.

tara: I'll add an API fallback header patch and append a line to release notes about graceful header fallthrough.

anika: Runtime team: we'll include KV_CACHE_FAST=true in rollout config and add a temporary kv eviction grace of 10s to avoid cache thrash during canary.

josh: Rollback plan drafted: immediate pin revert to previous versions if triggered — runtime v2.0.7, api v3.3.9, router v4.12.9, console v1.6.2. Ops runbook updated with exact helm commands and tag pins.

deploy-bot: deploy request created: /deploys/1715000000. Waiting for manual signoff from leads: josh, anika, tara, leo, maya. Reply 'signoff' to proceed.

leo: signoff :white_check_mark:
anika: signoff :white_check_mark:
tara: signoff :white_check_mark:
maya: signoff :white_check_mark:
josh: signoff — I'll watch metrics at go/no-go.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. Hold for 30m pre-window checks. Will post preflight checklist output here when complete.
